intro: Lotwil Veriatus is an eccentric gnomish scholar conducting dangerous elemental experiments in the dusty wastes of the Badlands. Stationed east of Kargath with his sarcastic apprentice Lucien Tosselwrench and a mechanical attendant named Servo, he is dedicated to blending arcane theory, alchemy, and engineering into a unified discipline.

p: Originally from Kharanos in Dun Morogh, Lotwil envisions a grand University for his Enlightened Assembly of Arcanology, Alchemy, and Engineering Sciences. He believes these three disciplines should not be practiced in isolation, but harmonized. In pursuit of this dream, he chose the harsh Badlands as his laboratory to study native rock elementals and construct binding shackles capable of mastering elemental forces. While an accomplished researcher—having studied elemental machines and defeated dark iron constructs in the past—his single-minded focus often blinds him to the explosive hazards of his fieldwork.
